text: 97 letters never fill a grid, so a hand worker leaves empty squares: at the end or start of a row, or down a side column. With two grids, the first grid's empty squares can vanish or travel on as dummy letters, struck out at the end.

Eight places for the empty squares in each grid, drop or keep, one grid (4 readings, widths 2-96) or two (clockwise turn or Sanborn's matrix, widths 2-48): 874,572 distinct routes, each with a repeating key on the sculpture's tables.
No key shorter than 21 fits K4 after any route; the coppers reach 20. K4 is above every copper in 0 of 52 cells, a copper 0-2 against the rest.
